site_url.description: The Search Console property, as Search Console stores it, e.g. https://www.example.com/ or sc-domain:example.com.

current.description: The raw output of the Search Analytics query for the last 28 days, with dimensions query and page.

previous.description: The raw output of the same query for the 28 days before that. Without it, content decay is not checked.

year_ago.description: The raw output of the same query for the same 28 days a year earlier, for year-over-year context.

brand_terms.description: Words that mark a branded query, one per line or comma-separated. Empty: the first label of the site's host.

top_n.description: How many opportunities to return. Default 10.

min_impressions.description: The fewest impressions a query needs to count. Default 50.
